mapper.subject: Welcome to Apex Dynamics, {{1.`1`}}
mapper.content:
Hello {{1.`1`}},

Welcome aboard, and thank you for choosing us for {{1.`4`}}. We are glad to be working with {{1.`3`}}.

What happens next

  1. We have created a shared folder for your project. You can open it here: your client folder.
  2. Within one working day, we will confirm your kickoff date.
  3. Before kickoff, please add any files or access details to the Notes folder.

If anything changes in the meantime, just reply to this email.

Kind regards,
Apex Dynamics
